notes: Fixes the dark-mode layout bug on the Oct 26/27 pages: the Hangzhou 2-day page's stylesheet was injected globally, so its body { max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; padding:18px; background:#f8f9fa; color:#222 } shrank the whole app page, painted light margins around the dark cards, and forced dark text onto the dark topbar — invisible in light mode, glaring in dark mode. That stylesheet is now scoped to the 2-day section only, and its light boxes (timing, stops, food, DiDi table) get dark backgrounds in dark mode so text is readable. Topbar title now explicitly uses the theme text colour.
